correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration of all nonempty 16-vertex subsets found f=(16,80,144,80), no five-vertex independent set and no maximal face below dimension three. Exact elimination gave rank 79 for the third boundary over both Q and F₂. Solving over Q and clearing denominators gave a primitive signed cycle, normalized at (0,2,5,7), with seed weights (1,−1,2,1), the stated four facet-orbit sizes and the six tabulated triangle-orbit boundary rows. Signed rotation and reflection fix the cycle. Its coefficients have gcd one and magnitudes 1 on 64 facets and 2 on 16, so the rank-one integral kernel, ℓ₁=96 and the unique nonzero mod-two cycle with 64 facets follow. Any proper induced subcomplex omits a facet because every vertex belongs to a tetrahedron; its top cycles embed into the ambient kernel, so it has none. Independent replay checked the unique immediate coface at all 106 deletion moves; the remainder is precisely the stated connected closed triangulated surface of Euler characteristic two. The link pieces likewise are spheres and cover the entire link, and their intersection is a connected surface with one boundary cycle and Euler characteristic one, hence a disk. The two inclusions of the disk are cofibrations, so their union has the claimed wedge type. The word ‘partitioned’ in the proof should read ‘covered’: the shared disk has four triangles, as the very next statement and the certificates specify. This slip does not change the defined pieces or the argument. Translation transports both local certificates to every vertex.
residual_risks: The finite certificates apply to this labeled circulant, with translation supplying the universal vertex quantifier, not to other circulants.

checked_sources: Independent rank, orbit and collapse computations
value.rationale: The standard exceptional circulant is a natural test of what shellability does not specify. The exact integral cycle shows that all vertices and all facets are necessary in characteristic zero even though 16 facet coefficients disappear modulo two. In addition, the deletion certificate gives a direct simple-homotopy description on each vertex removal, rather than just a Betti count. Those are useful finite facts about the canonical example, independent of credit for the already implied wedge types.
residual_risks: No extension to a family or classification of all deletion collapses is asserted.
